SEARCH
Package entities

Class Reservation

java.lang.Object
entities.Reservation
public class Reservation extends Object
Represents a table reservation in the restaurant system. This class stores all data related to a booking, including customer contact info, scheduled times, actual arrival/departure tracking, and status.
